followUps.title: Move Linear MCP access to Managed Agents secrets
followUps.whyItMatters: This lets Managed Agents use Linear without storing a private token in repository files.
followUps.recommendedAction: Configure Linear MCP with a secret-backed token and keep only non-secret connection details in version control.

followUps.title: Choose which Claude commands should become Pi workflows
followUps.whyItMatters: Porting the useful commands makes future Managed Agents sessions feel like the current Claude workflow.
followUps.recommendedAction: Review the migration plan and convert approved commands into Pi skills or prompt templates.

followUps.title: Review Git automation before recreating it
followUps.whyItMatters: The existing Claude setup can stage, commit, sync, and push automatically; copying that behavior without approval could surprise users.
followUps.recommendedAction: Design an explicit Managed Agents Git workflow with the level of automation the user wants.

followUps.title: Port safe vault guardrails
followUps.whyItMatters: Schema validation and output-location reminders help keep the knowledge vault consistent.
followUps.recommendedAction: Rebuild the safe parts of the Claude hook router as Pi-friendly validation commands or skills.

followUps.title: Enable image generation only with approved secrets
followUps.whyItMatters: The visuals workflow needs a Gemini key and should not store API keys in the repository.
followUps.recommendedAction: Add GEMINI_API_KEY through Managed Agents secrets before porting the image-generation skill.
